title: Find the full names and phone numbers of members in leadership roles (posit
question: Find the full names and phone numbers of members in leadership roles (position not 'Member') who have incurred more than one approved expense and whose total spending exceeds the average cost of all individual expenses.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036", T1."XCL_040"
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_022"
WHERE T1."XCL_038" <> 'Member'
  AND T2."XCL_021" = 'true'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_034"
HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_017") > 1
   AND SUM(T2."XCL_020") > (SELECT AVG("XCL_020") FROM expense)
